author: Evan Edinger
description:
The American accent that sounds Southern, Canadian, British, and more at the same time!
Thanks to NordVPN for sponsoring! https://nordvpn.com/evan
Starring Rob Words! https://youtube.com/@robwords

Thanks so much for watching! This video has taken me an absolute age to create! I started working on it last summer, and it ballooned and ballooned! But I had a blast.
